name: XPath 1.0/2.0 Parser & Evaluation System in C++20

mentions.name: XPath 1.0/2.0 Parser & Evaluation System in C++20
mentions.description: An XPath 1.0 parser and evaluation system implemented from scratch in C++20, with XPath 2.0 support currently being added. The project comprises 10.5K lines of code and 774 individual tests to ensure compliance with the W3C spec, developed with heavy use of AI coding tools (Codex and Claude).
mentions.source_excerpt: In the last 7 days I implemented a complete XPath 1.0 parser & evaluation system from scratch in C++20.  Right now I'm adding support for XPath 2.0.
